label: A help video link a page may frame
description_nl: True when the link is a player known to allow framing (YouTube /embed/, Vimeo's player, a plain .mp4). Anything else is offered as a plain link instead of an iframe.
weight_basis: A yes/no or a value the portal acts on. The knobs ARE the policy — edit them here, never in Python. Owner-only (audience admin): a looser value here would open a security hole or spend the owner's disk, so editors see and test it but cannot change it.
